Enduring Partnership and Advancements in Grinding Technology # 16 Years’ Cooperation Between AUTO STRONG and CCM, Designating the Use of COMORK Machinery Ko-Yen General Manager Quan-ji Zhou (left) visits AUTO STRONG’s Vice General Manager Ming-Hsiung Chang (right) In 2015, at the Taipei International Machine Tool Show (TIMTOS), Ko-Yen made a significant impression by displaying a red banner that read: “Subverting tradition: One-time processing for multiple-side shaping processing, increasing performance by 50%.” This bold statement was backed by the successful sale of the GJ-400 model showcased at the event, generating considerable momentum for the company.
AUTO STRONG, a leader in the power chucks and hydraulic cylinders sector, has maintained a strong partnership with Chuan-Yen (CCM) for over 16 years. The collaboration began in 2005, when CCM responded to AUTO STRONG’s positioning in the global high-end device market by providing specialized grinding processing services. CCM’s production capabilities and commitment to quality quickly distinguished it from competitors, drawing the attention of AUTO STRONG’s President, Chiu-Fa Hsueh. After visiting CCM and discovering its in-house machinery manufacturing, President Hsueh recognized CCM’s technological edge in grinding processes and commended its dedication to innovation and continuous improvement.
This encouragement played a pivotal role in the establishment of COMORK Precise Machinery Co., Ltd. in 2011, with AUTO STRONG as its inaugural client. AUTO STRONG acquired four sets of machinery from Ko-Yen, significantly enhancing its capacity to meet growing market demands.
A standout product from this collaboration is the COMORK GJ-400 CNC Internal Cylindrical Compound Grinding Machine. This model features self-developed interactive software, enabling users to customize the processing interface according to their requirements. The result is a substantial increase in production flexibility, optimized processing procedures, and reduced production costs—all while boosting capacity and fulfilling customer needs.
Ko-Yen’s approach is rooted in over two decades of CNC grinding experience. As both an end-user and manufacturer, the company is dedicated to research and development, adhering to the philosophy that “rolling stones gather no moss.” Achieving zero-tolerance precision in machinery is seen as a gradual, step-by-step process. Ko-Yen believes that each grinding operation presents an opportunity for improvement, and continuous self-improvement is essential for creating greater value for partners and advancing the Taiwanese brand in the global market.

From Ocean Resilience to Precision Grinding Innovation # President Quan-ji Zhou’s journey began in Qingkunshen, Taiwan, where he was raised in a family dependent on the sea. The unpredictable nature of the ocean instilled in him resilience, keen intuition, and a drive for excellence. Through years of accumulated experience, Zhou refined his expertise in grinding technology, channeling his knowledge into the field of machine manufacturing. This dedication has enabled COMORK to deliver outstanding services to upstream clients and address the evolving demands of the global grinding industry.
Drawing from his own life, President Zhou emphasizes the importance of “the foundation of technology and the sources of achievement”—a philosophy that guides the discovery and cultivation of value for team members and clients alike. COMORK is committed to giving back to society, working alongside partners to pursue excellence in grinding, navigate market challenges, and create lasting value for all stakeholders.
COMORK team at work Precision machinery in action Grinding excellence at COMORK Brand Extensions: COMORK and CCM – Born for the Ultimate Grinding # In 2011, CCM expanded its brand by establishing COMORK Precise Machinery Co., Ltd. The COMORK brand stands for flawless craftsmanship, integrating quality, precision, and true grinding into every machine.
Company Milestones # 1997–2003 # Founded in 1997, CCM focused on research and development in grinding processing. As advanced grinding technologies were developed, the company experienced a surge in orders and expanded its production facilities. By integrating internal resources, CCM began offering comprehensive services.
2003–2010 # CCM invested in independent R&D, managing the entire process from raw materials to finished products. The acquisition of Zeiss three-dimensional measuring machines further enhanced product competitiveness, enabling one-stop grinding production services tailored to market needs.
2011 # Building on Chuan-Yen’s technological foundation, Ko-Yen Precise Machinery Co., Ltd. was officially established on August 5th to meet market demands. In September, Ko-Yen launched the internal grinding spindle series under the CCM brand, introducing high-precision, high-performance CNC grinding machines that set new standards in innovative craftsmanship.
2012–2017 # With significant technological breakthroughs, Ko-Yen successfully developed the GJ-400 and GO-350 CNC internal cylindrical compound grinding machines, as well as the GO-354 and GO-356 CNC cylindrical grinding machines. These products made their debut at the Taipei Intelligent Machinery & Manufacturing Technology Show and TIMTOS, where on-site sales significantly increased brand visibility.
2018–2021 # In 2018, Ko-Yen acquired land for expansion. By the end of 2020, the new plant was operational, providing a more comfortable work environment. The refreshed COMORK brand continues to deliver top-quality services and a renewed presence to clients.

Embracing Circular Economy in Precision Machinery # KO-YAN Precision Machinery (COMORK), situated in the heart of Taiwan’s precision machinery cluster, distinguishes itself through a commitment to sustainable manufacturing and circular economy principles. Leveraging over two decades of expertise in precision machining, the company places a strong emphasis on user experience in equipment research and development, offering tangible benefits to the industry.
KO-YAN Machinery’s new factory in Taiping, Taichung Integrating Circular Economy Concepts # At the start of 2024, consultants from the Plastics Industry Technology Development Center visited KO-YAN’s facility to promote and assess the implementation of circular economy concepts. This collaboration provided valuable insights into optimizing every stage of the equipment lifecycle—from design and manufacturing to usage and recycling—positioning KO-YAN as a key driver in helping customers adopt circular economy practices.
Industrial Cycle Thinking in Action # KO-YAN Machinery applies its robust metal processing and R&D capabilities to serve clients with an ‘industrial cycle’ mindset. This approach is reflected in several core areas:
Product Design: By modularizing mechanical components, KO-YAN ensures that equipment is easy to disassemble, repair, upgrade, remanufacture, and recycle. This design philosophy extends the durability of machinery, conserves energy, and reduces resource consumption.
Process Optimization: The innovative GO-350CNC internal and external diameter compound grinder combines the functions of internal and external diameter grinding. This integration not only meets stringent accuracy and yield requirements but also enables users to perform multi-surface grinding in a single clamping operation. The result is enhanced production efficiency, better space utilization, and maximized resource efficiency.
COMORK's GO-350CNC Internal and External Diameter Compound Grinder Refurbishment and Remanufacturing: Through comprehensive inspection and replacement of parts, KO-YAN restores equipment to a nearly new condition. This practice extends the service life of machinery and reduces the generation of scrap metal, such as casings, thereby contributing to carbon reduction. International Presence and Recognition # KO-YAN Precision Machinery actively participates in international exhibitions to showcase its OEM/ODM grinding machines and solutions. Following the pandemic, the company arranged for multiple international events, including its inaugural appearance at GrindingHub 2024 in Stuttgart, Germany, organized by the German Machine Tool Manufacturers Association (VDW).
COMORK Attended GrindingHub 2024 and Received Multiple Groups of Buyers COMORK Attended GrindingHub 2024 and Received Multiple Groups of Buyers The event was a notable success, attracting numerous buyers and generating positive feedback from European markets. General Manager Zhou Quanji highlighted the strong potential of the COMORK brand in Europe, with active inquiries from Germany, Turkey, and other Eurasian regions.
By integrating circular economy concepts into its operations and maintaining an international outlook, KO-YAN Precision Machinery (COMORK) continues to support customers in achieving low-carbon manufacturing and sustainable industrial practices.
